name: Study Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Per Angola's Migration and Foreigners Service (SME), the Study Visa is issued for academic programs or professional training, valid 60 days before use, and permits a one-year stay (renewable) with multiple entries. It allows internship-related work only, no general employment.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment in an academic program or professional training course in Angola, then apply for the Study Visa at a consulate.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 1+ year with 4+ blank pages

sources.title: Serviço de Migração e Estrangeiros (SME) -- official Study Visa category: purpose, validity, renewal, internship-only work rights

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Angola). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- read directly from Angola's own migration authority. work_rights set to 'restricted' since only internship-related work tied to the study program is permitted, not general employment. family_can_join set to false at this file's outcome level since a student's family joins through the separate Visto de Permanência Temporária mechanism (ao_family_reunification.json), which explicitly lists family accompaniment of study-visa holders as one of its qualifying categories.
